source: Hidden: how simulated patients respond to outreach. The product never reads this; it only sees replies, opt-outs and bookings
benchmarks: Tuned in docs/12_benchmarks.md: text reminders raise attendance about 11 points (Cochrane CD007458); outreach to overdue patients moves a similar amount; SMS opt-outs about 0.5% per send (Postscript)

natural.note: chance of booking in the window with no outreach: recall_compliance x scale, or trust x (1 - price_sensitivity / 2) x scale

lift.note: share of people who would not have acted that outreach moves, scaled by each person's responsiveness and trust
